subject: ela
skillName: Compare two texts on same topic

items.prompt:
Two books are both about dogs. They are the SAME because:
A) Both are about dogs
B) One is about cats
C) They have no topic

Book 1 has a photo of a cat; Book 2 has a drawing. They are DIFFERENT in their:
A) Topic
B) Pictures
C) Covers only

steps: Photo vs drawing. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Both books tell facts about the sun. One way they are the SAME:
A) Both about the sun
B) One is about the moon
C) They are stories

Book 1 is about big dogs; Book 2 is about small dogs. They are DIFFERENT because:
A) Both about dogs
B) One is big dogs, one is small
C) Both about cats
items.answer: B) One is big dogs, one is small

solution.answer: B) One is big dogs, one is small

items.prompt:
Both books teach facts and have pictures. One way they are the SAME:
A) Both teach facts
B) Different topics
C) One is a poem

Book 1 uses real photos; Book 2 uses cartoons. They are DIFFERENT in their:
A) Topic
B) Kind of pictures
C) Number of pages only

steps: Photos vs cartoons. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Both books are about the ocean, but one tells about fish and the other about waves. What is the SAME?
A) The topic (the ocean)
B) The details
C) Nothing

steps: Same big topic, different details. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Book 1 tells HOW plants grow; Book 2 tells WHY we need plants. The DIFFERENCE is:
A) Both about plants
B) One tells how, the other tells why
C) They have covers
items.answer: B) One tells how, the other tells why

steps: Different focus on the same topic. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) One tells how, the other tells why
